data.narrative:
HyImpulse is a Series B-stage space and aerospace company that has raised €74M ($74M equivalent) to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 4 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private peers (Sierra Space, Cowboy Space Corporation, Aalyria, and Skyryse) plus 5 public comparables in the Space & Aerospace sector (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL).

Two methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a typical 1.9x Series B step-up multiplier to the $74M total raised proxy, yielding $141M. Peer-median anchoring uses the four private comparables, which trade at a median valuation of $1.6B with a range of $1.1B to $8.0B, directly reflecting market pricing for operators at similar stages. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied because HyImpulse's revenue is not disclosed; the sector P/S median of 25.3x across public names cannot be meaningfully applied without that input.

The triangulated analysis across the two applicable methods supports a valuation range of $120M (low) to $1.9B (high), with a median of $895M. The wide range reflects genuine uncertainty: stage-progression suggests the lower bound based on capital deployed, while peer-median anchoring points substantially higher, suggesting either that comparable companies command significant premiums at this stage or that HyImpulse's positioning warrants positioning toward the upper range. Clarity on revenue run-rate and customer traction would narrow this band materially.
